full_judgment: 6. Mr. Abdur Rahim has also urged as to possession of the plaintiff and had taken pains in taking me through the evidence on record to show that there existed evidence on record to show that the plaintiff was in possession since 1357 B.S. corresponding to 1950 A.D. This question of possession would be irrelevant in the facts and circumstances of the case as plaintiff's possession must be referable either to the settlement or possession adversely and the claim of adverse possession having been abandoned at the trial the question of settlement would be the only point that remained and the said also could not be proved by the plaintiff to the satisfaction of the Court. A mere possession would not create title further when the said claim contradicts the entry in the names of the sons of the landlords in the khatian respecting the land in question as an entry in the khatian is also evidence of possession. No other points urged. All having been found against the petitioner I find no substance in this revisional application.
